title: Settings
subtitle: Choose how your organization works. Pick a section to change it.

appearance.heading: Appearance
appearance.scannerLayoutHorizontalDescription: Scanner in sidebar, cards on the right
appearance.scannerLayoutVerticalDescription: Scanner on top, card grid below

pricing.heading: Pricing
pricing.description: Choose which marketplace prices your organization's cards, collection values and Discord posts use. Card Kingdom only prices Magic: The Gathering cards.

conditionPricing.heading: Condition pricing
conditionPricing.description: How much of the Near Mint price a card in each condition is worth. Card values, collection totals, stats and storage values all use these.
conditionPricing.baseNote: Near Mint is always the full market price. The defaults match what most big sellers use.

sessionWrapped.heading: Session Wrapped
sessionWrapped.description: Show a Wrapped-style recap of stat highlights before the export summary.

ocr.heading: Text recognition (OCR)
ocr.description: When a scan isn't a confident match, read the card's name and set line to find it. Applies to every scanner in this organization, for games with text regions set up.
ocr.highAccuracyDescription: Read the text on every card, not only uncertain ones, so the set and number can correct a confident but wrong match. Scans take a little longer.

foilDetection.heading: Foil detection
foilDetection.description: Mark a scan as foil automatically. Only used for printings that come in both foil and non-foil, and only while the scanner's foil setting is off.
foilDetection.starToggleDescription: Mark Magic cards as foil when the collector line shows the ★ printed on foils. Works on every device and adds no time.
foilDetection.toggleLabel: Detect foils by nudging the card
foilDetection.nudgeToggleDescription: Works for every game while a sorter with up-to-date firmware is connected. The sorter gently rocks the card a little to each side while it stays in place, and photos show whether its shine changes. Adds about a second per card.

draft.saveFailed: Couldn't save your settings. Try again.

correctionAutoClose.heading: Card correction prompt
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleLabel: Ask me to move corrected cards
correctionAutoClose.promptToggleDescription: Turn this off if you leave corrected cards where they were sorted. The card keeps its current bin and no prompt is shown.
correctionAutoClose.description: After you correct or identify a card, a prompt shows which bin it's in and which bin it belongs in. Auto-close accepts that you moved the card once the time runs out, so you don't have to click.
correctionAutoClose.toggleLabel: Auto-close and mark the card as moved

deployPause.heading: Updates
deployPause.description: When Mault is being updated, any sorter that's scanning is paused and a prompt explains why, so no cards are lost if a save fails mid-update. You can resume straight away from the prompt.

leaderboard.heading: Leaderboard
leaderboard.description: Every organization is ranked by how many cards it has scanned on the leaderboard in Stats and in the Discord bot. Organizations that don't opt in show as anonymous.
leaderboard.toggleLabel: Show my organization's name on the leaderboard

sectionIntros.general: Your language, accent color and scanner layout, and whether your organization's name shows on the leaderboard.
sectionIntros.organization: Rename your organization, invite people and choose what each member can do.
sectionIntros.billing: See your plan and usage, and upgrade or manage your subscription.
sectionIntros.scanning: Choose how cards are identified, print control cards, and decide what happens when a scan needs a correction.
sectionIntros.pricing: Choose where card prices come from, how much each condition is worth, and how you price cards you sell and buy.
sectionIntros.sounds: Play a sound when a scanned card matches a rule, like a chime for valuable cards.
sectionIntros.notifications: Link your Discord server and choose which scans and alerts get posted where.
sectionIntros.integrations: Create API keys and webhooks so your shop or other tools can see where your cards are stored.
sectionIntros.business: Choose what members can see and do.
sectionIntros.raspberry-pis: Link a Raspberry Pi sorter to this organization, then start and stop its scans from here.
sectionIntros.profile: Your public page at mault.xyz/@handle with your links, shop catalogs and favorite cards.

controlCards.heading: Control cards
controlCards.description: Print QR cards that switch the collection, rule preset, foil type, set, condition or scan options when the sorter reads one. Feed a card through mid-run and it goes where unmatched cards go.

raspberryPis.heading: Linked Raspberry Pis
raspberryPis.description: A linked Pi saves the cards it scans to this organization. Start a scan here and it runs on the Pi.
raspberryPis.linkDescription: Turn on the Pi and set it up with Mault. It shows an 8-character code: enter it here.
raspberryPis.codeDescription: Run sudo mault link on the Pi to see the code again.
raspberryPis.linkFailed: Could not link the Raspberry Pi.
raspberryPis.managersOnly: Only owners and admins can link or remove a Raspberry Pi. Anyone in the organization can start a scan.
raspberryPis.loadFailed: Could not load your Raspberry Pis.
raspberryPis.emptyDescription: Set up a Pi with the Mault image or installer and choose your Mault account.
raspberryPis.removeConfirmDescription: The Pi stops scanning for this organization and needs a new code to link again. Cards it already saved stay.
raspberryPis.removeFailed: Could not remove the Raspberry Pi.
raspberryPis.offlineHint: Check that the Pi is turned on and connected to the internet.
raspberryPis.scanFailed: The Raspberry Pi could not do that.
raspberryPis.startDescription: The Pi feeds and sorts cards into the collection you choose.
raspberryPis.foilDescription: Saves every card with this foil type.
raspberryPis.setsDescription: Set codes to prefer when a card matches several printings. Separate them with commas.
raspberryPis.autoFeedDescription: Turn off to feed one card at a time with Feed next card.
raspberryPis.duplicatesDescription: Save a card again when the same copy is scanned twice in a row.
raspberryPis.renameFailed: Could not rename the Raspberry Pi.
raspberryPis.cameraUnavailable: The camera could not be reached. Close it and try again.

update.updating: Updating. The Pi restarts and is back online in a few minutes.
update.failed: The last update didn't finish, so the Pi stayed on version {{version}}.
